instagram_caption:
Jesus, my best friend told everyone my secret?

She trusted one person with the thing she had never said out loud, and by Tuesday it belonged to everyone.

The part that stings most is not the gossip. It is wondering whether she was stupid to trust at all. Jesus does not let her carry that one. "You are not stupid for trusting. She is responsible for what she did with it."

2 Corinthians 2:7-8 is about the moment forgiveness becomes possible, not the moment the hurt stops mattering.

Both things can be true. You can grieve the friendship and still refuse to become harder because of it.
